sections.changelog:
Fixed

  • **Bundled MVweb Hub menu class refreshed to ship the full plugin catalog.** The copy of `class-mvweb-menu.php` bundled with this plugin lagged behind the shared source and carried an empty catalog (no `CATALOG`/`CATALOG_VERSION`). Because the hub renders its "available plugins" promo from the newest catalog any installed plugin contributes, a site whose freshest plugin was this one showed no available-plugins list. Re-synced the bundled class from the shared source so this plugin now contributes the complete, current catalog.
